title: Another Year Sweeter (tee, sweatshirt, mug, art print, sticker)

general-counsel-agent.note: All ten checks on file. Nothing commits the owner: no Printify product was created, nothing is published, prices are suggestions. BIRTHDAY SEASON was rejected at the screen before any art (registered for art prints).

advertising-consumer-protection-counsel.note: Description checked against the full-size art: a pale pink layer cake with cream shell borders at the top and foot, swags with rosettes and hanging drops, sugar pearls, deeper pink string loops, a red satin bow, five glossy cherries, five striped candles (blue, pink, yellow, lavender, green) with lit flames, a mint milk-glass cake stand with white hobnail dots, a mint polka-dot present and a pink striped present, confetti and gold sparkles; 'ANOTHER YEAR' in berry capitals above and 'Sweeter' in pink script below. No best-seller, sale, free or review claims; no food or health claims (the cake is art, not a product).

email-anti-spam-compliance-counsel.note: No commercial email. The delivery note goes only to the owner.

privacy-data-protection-counsel.note: No personal data: no names, ages or dates on the design, and no per-order personalization.

copyright-fair-use-counsel.note: Art is original, painted by the studio's own code (watercolor.py and motifs2.py, with the new birthday_cake, candle, flame, cherry, satin bow and confetti painting written today; gift2 reused with new soft-shading options). No stock art, traced designs, competitor art or AI image generator. The vintage piped (Lambeth-style) cake is a general decorating style, not any bakery's or seller's design; the cherry-cake tees found are flat retro graphics, and ours shares no art or layout with them. Fonts Playfair Display and Pacifico are SIL OFL 1.1. Machine-drawn art may not be registrable for US copyright (Thaler v. Perlmutter).

trademark-brand-clearance-counsel.note: Screened before art (listing.trademark_check): BIRTHDAY SEASON rejected (reg. 4958597, art prints). No ANOTHER YEAR SWEETER mark found for any goods and no product using the phrase found. SWEETER COLLECTIVE and SWEETER TOGETHER (new applications), YEAR (Class 25) are different marks. BIRTHDAY MONTH (reg. 6166042, clothing) and BIRTHDAY GIRL (serial 85498719) are kept out of titles and tags. 'Coquette' is a style word used descriptively. Search-engine screen only; tmsearch.uspto.gov is blocked from our sessions, so the owner may run a USPTO search on ANOTHER YEAR SWEETER before listing.

platform-terms-policy-counsel.note: Etsy: the standard description carries the production-partner disclosure. Titles are 140 characters or fewer (122-127) and every listing has 13 unique tags of 20 characters or fewer (build.py checked). The lit candles are a drawing; no fire-safety claims.

kids-content-coppa-counsel.note: Adult sizes; marketed to adults ('gift for her', 'birthday gift women'), not made or marketed for children.

fixes: Quality Bar, preview 1: the lower half of the cake was see-through (the stand's plate showed through it), the side shading had hard panel edges, the shells at the ends of each border stood up like spikes, the centre candle stood on the front cherry, the roses at the foot read as blobs and the confetti clumped. The cake body is now painted in front of the stand, the side shading is blurred, shells are foreshortened at the sides, the centre candle moved back, the roses were replaced by two wrapped presents and the confetti keeps pieces apart.

Quality Bar, preview 2: the presents looked flat and floated away from the stand, and 'ANOTHER YEAR' was small on a shirt. Presents moved in front of the stand's foot with soft contact shadows and a lighter outline; the top line enlarged from 0.085 to 0.105 of the design width.

Quality Bar, full size: flames were lightbulb-shaped with hard-edged halo rings, shells had hard inner shadows and read as petals, the swags had hard stripes inside, the cherries had hard dark spots, the bow knot showed an 'x' where the tails crossed, the stand's foot was drawn as a crossed shape (it looked like overlapping glass), the presents had a grey band under the lid, and two confetti pieces sat on the gold sparkles. New teardrop flame with a soft glow and a gouache core; blurred shell shadows plus a highlight on each shell; soft shadow and highlight along each swag; blurred cherry shading; tails start under the knot; the foot is a closed top-and-rim shape with the stem painted in front; presents shaded in their own darker color; confetti keeps clear of the sparkles. Checked again at full size.
